title: Primitive Technology: Stone Axe (celt)
summary: The Primitive Technology channel shows the making of a stone axe (celt) using only primitive tools and materials, from shaping and polishing a basalt head to making the wooden handle and hafting it.
why: HN people value its authenticity: no cuts, no cheating, and real tool use done entirely with materials found on site.

quote.text: This entire channel is fascinating and strives to be very “authentic” about doing everything without turning off the camera and cheating.
